title: Rectangular prism
spec: Create a new coordinate system with Euler angles set to zero degrees for all axes and a translation vector of 0.0, 0.0, 0.375 units. Begin by drawing the first face of the 2D sketch. In the first loop, start at the origin (0.0, 0.0) and draw a line to (0.0469, 0.0), then continue to (0.0469, 0.0094), (0.0094, 0.0094), (0.0094, 0.0469), (0.0469, 0.0469), (0.0469, 0.0562), (0.0, 0.0562), and finally back to the origin. Scale the entire 2D sketch by a factor of 0.0562. Rotate the scaled 2D sketch using the same Euler angles and translate it using the same translation vector. Extrude the 2D sketch 0.1875 units in both the normal and opposite directions to create a 3D model. Perform a boolean operation to create a new solid body from the extruded 2D sketch. The final dimensions of the rectangular prism with rounded edges are 0.046875 units in length, 0.05625 units in width, and 0.375 units in height.

import cadquery as cq

# Define the sketch
sketch = cq.Workplane("XY").moveTo(0, 0).lineTo(0.0469, 0).lineTo(0.0469, 0.0094).lineTo(0.0094, 0.0094).lineTo(0.0094, 0.0469).lineTo(0.0469, 0.0469).lineTo(0.0469, 0.0562).lineTo(0, 0.0562).close()

# Extrude the sketch
extruded = sketch.extrude(0.1875, both=True)

# Translate the extruded shape
translated = extruded.translate((0, 0, 0.375))

# Assign the final model to 'r'
r = translated

import cadquery as cq

# Dimensions from bounding box
X = 0.0469   # outer width in X
Y = 0.0562   # outer depth in Y
Z = 0.3750   # extrusion height in Z
t = 0.0078   # wall thickness

# Outer rectangle profile in XY plane
outer = cq.Workplane("XY").moveTo(0, 0).lineTo(X, 0).lineTo(X, Y).lineTo(0, Y).close()

# Inner cutout (opening on +X side, leaving left wall and top/bottom flanges)
inner = cq.Workplane("XY").moveTo(t, t).lineTo(X, t).lineTo(X, Y - t).lineTo(t, Y - t).close()

# Create the C-channel by subtracting the inner cutout
r = outer.extrude(Z).cut(inner.extrude(Z))

import cadquery as cq

# Base dimensions
X = 0.0469
Y = 0.0562
Z = 0.3750

# Base plate (rectangular prism)
base = cq.Workplane("XY").box(X, Y, Z, centered=(True, True, False))

# Create a rectangular cutout (cavity) in the middle of the base
cavity_width = 0.030
cavity_height = 0.030
cavity_depth = 0.020

cavity = cq.Workplane("XY").center(0, 0).rect(cavity_width, cavity_height).extrude(-cavity_depth)

# Subtract the cavity from the base
r = base.cut(cavity)

# Add a cylindrical hole through the base
hole_diameter = 0.015
hole = cq.Workplane("XY").center(0, 0).circle(hole_diameter/2).extrude(Z + 0.001)  # extra length to ensure through-hole
r = r.cut(hole)
